start: Owner signed in; Plans has no PT plan yet

steps.action: Plans: add a plan with 12 PT sessions and trainer 'Rohit'
user_sees: The plan's line: 'PT · 12 sessions · Trainer Rohit'
must_not: More than 200 sessions accepted
A trainer name longer than 40 letters kept

steps.action: Sell it to a member and open their page
user_sees: A PT block: '<pack name> · runs until <date>', 0 of 12 used
must_not: The PT pack changing the member's gym plan status or last day

steps.action: Tap 'Mark session'
user_sees: 'PT session marked.'; the button reads 'Session marked today' and is off; 1 of 12 used
must_not: Two sessions used by a double tap
A session marked for a day that has not happened

start: Owner; a member renewed PT early, so two packs run at once (old pack 10 of 12 used)

steps.action: Open the member's page
user_sees: '2 PT packs running. Sessions are used from the oldest pack first.'
Each pack: '<name> · 10 of 12 used · until <date>', with ' · next session' on the pack in use
must_not: The new pack used while the old pack still has paid sessions

steps.action: Tap 'Mark session'
user_sees: The old pack goes to 11 of 12
must_not: The session taken from the newer pack

steps.action: Open Members and tap the 'PT ending' chip
user_sees: Members whose running packs have 2 sessions or fewer left between them, or whose last pack ends within 7 days; this member is not listed, because a later pack is already there
must_not: A member with a pack already bought and waiting listed as 'PT ending'
The chip shown when nobody is ending

start: Owner; PT packs that cannot take a session

steps.action: Open a member whose 12 sessions are all used
user_sees: 'All 12 PT sessions used. Time to renew.' and a 'Renew PT' button in place of 'Mark session'
must_not: A 13th session marked
'Mark session' still offered

steps.action: Open a member whose pack ended last week with 3 sessions unused
user_sees: 'Ended on <date> with 3 sessions left'; no 'Mark session' for that pack
must_not: A session marked after the last day (the save answers 'This PT plan ended on <date>. The owner can extend it (Freeze / extra days).')

steps.action: Try 'Mark session' with the internet off
user_sees: The button does not save and says the internet is needed (exact words unknown: not read)
must_not: 'PT session marked.' for a session that was not saved

start: Owner; a session was marked yesterday on the wrong member

steps.action: Open that member's page and tap 'Undo last session'
user_sees: Used goes down by one; 'Mark session' is offered again
must_not: The session taken back from the wrong pack when two are running

steps.action: Mark a session today, then tap 'Undo last session'
user_sees: Today's session comes back; the button reads 'Mark session' again
must_not: Two sessions taken back by one tap

steps.action: Use sessions until 2 are left, then 1
user_sees: 'Only 2 PT sessions left', then 'Only 1 PT session left'
must_not: 'Only 1 PT sessions left'

start: Owner marks a session; the member has the MettleUp app

steps.action: Tap 'Mark session'
user_sees: The pack's count on the member's page
must_not: PT counts of another gym's members

steps.action: Look at the member's app
user_sees: Their own count only, in the words 'Personal training: {left} of {total} left. Ask the desk to add more.'
must_not: A different number of sessions left on the app than in the panel
The price of the pack or other members' PT shown to the member
